[Verse]
Down by the cliffs where the wild waves roar
The fisherman casts from the rugged shore
With dreams of the sea in the salt-stained air
He's chasing a freedom that's never there

[Verse 2]
The gulls cry sharp as the cold winds bite
The whiskey burns in the throat of the night
A net full of nothing
But he keeps it near
A hope for tomorrow
Drowning out fear

[Chorus]
Oh
Fish for the stars where the waters blend
The sea's no master
She's just a friend
A lonely song where the tide rolls deep
The fisherman's dream
It's a secret to keep

[Verse 3]
Lanterns swayin'
Shadows stretch wide
He stands alone with the rolling tide
Rust on his hands
And rags on his back
But the sea keeps callin'
To the blue
He'll track

[Bridge]
In the pub
He hums a tune from the past
With eyes that know the storms won't last
Each tale he spins is a hookline snare
Woven with the winds and a sailor's prayer

[Chorus]
Oh
Fish for the stars where the waters blend
The sea's no master
She's just a friend
A lonely song where the tide rolls deep
The fisherman's dream
It's a secret to keep

Love’s a shout a whisper full of doubt
Keep it loud till the sun runs dry
In this corset we’re kissing the sky

The misfit anthem is alive somewhere
Laced up tight but breaking free
Pink corset fits a reckless spree

Woke up to a river I definitely forgot

Sewage waves rolling right through my door

Granny flat living's a luxury no more

 

[Chorus]

Flooded dreams oh they're washing me down

Bathroom tides turned my world around

Routine disaster but hey it's home

Sewage floods and I’m not alone

 

[Verse 2]

Mop in hand I fought the tide

The stench of victory stung my pride

Granny flat walls they're paper thin

Every wave feels like a personal sin

 

[Chorus]

Flooded dreams oh they're washing me down

Bathroom tides turned my world around

Routine disaster but hey it's home

Sewage floods and I’m not alone

 

[Bridge]

Oh the joy of that gurgling sound

Every step squelches on unstable ground

Who needs a yacht when the bathroom's a sea

Luxury living is drowning me

 

[Verse 3]

Buckets of bleach and hope in my heart

Each cleanup feels like modern art

Granny flat life ain't what it seems

Sailing through these sewage dreams
[Verse]
Woke up drifting on a brown tide bed
Pillow’s a sponge soaking what was said
Granny flat’s tiny and the walls do weep
Sewage water rising while I try to sleep

[Verse 2]
My mattress is a raft
Oh what a ride
Bathroom floods turn my nights to a slide
Routine disaster
Yeah it’s all the same
Life on the water
But it’s no cruise game

[Chorus]
Floating in sewage dreams
Oh how it seems
Life’s a leaky pipe
Not a Hollywood scene
Paddling through the mess with my soul intact
Granny flat survival
That's a real hard fact

[Verse 3]
The landlord says
“It’s fine
Just mop it up”
But the stench says otherwise
I’ve had enough
My life’s a swamp
And I’m wading through
Rats doing backstrokes
Oh what’s a girl to do

[Bridge]
Oh
The glamour of my little flooded home
Waterlogged journals
Nowhere left to roam
Beneath the surface
Truths start to glow
This sewage river’s got nowhere else to flow

[Chorus]
Floating in sewage dreams
Oh how it seems
Life’s a leaky pipe
Not a Hollywood scene
Paddling through the mess with my soul intact
Granny flat survival
That's a real hard fact

Verse 1
Four cents sitting in my bank tonight
Screen glowing in the dark like a neon light
Cupboard’s quiet, stomach loud
Try to laugh but it comes out proud

I hate the words I have to say
“Can you help me just today?”
Feels like begging on my knees
Just to buy some bread and cheese

Pre-Chorus
You think I’m asking just to use you
But you don’t feel the way my hands shake

Chorus
I got four cents, but I’m still breathing
Heart still fighting, still believing
One day I won’t have to call
Won’t feel this small at all
I’m surviving every low
Every tear you never know
Four cents rich and holding on
Till the night turns into dawn

Verse 2
Blood sugar dropping like the rain
Head spinning circles in my brain
I don’t need your sympathy
I just need some dignity

I swear I’m trying every day
Writing songs to find a way
Dreaming louder than my fear
Hoping freedom’s getting near

Pre-Chorus
You think I’m weak when I reach out
But this is what survival’s about

Chorus
I got four cents, but I’m still breathing
Heart still fighting, still believing
One day I won’t have to call
Won’t feel this small at all
I’m surviving every low
Every tear you never know
Four cents rich and holding on
Till the night turns into dawn

Bridge
This won’t be my forever
This won’t be my name
I’m writing my escape
In every chord I play

Someday I’ll buy the groceries
And laugh about this pain

Final Chorus
I got four cents, but I’m still breathing
Heart still fighting, still believing
I can feel the morning come
I know it’s not the end
Four cents rich and rising up
On the truth inside my lungs
I won’t be here for long

Outro
Four cents tonight…
But tomorrow I’ll be strong.
